diffs.patch:
Index: package.json
===================================================================
--- package.json	
+++ package.json	
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+{
+  "name": "http-status-server",
+  "version": "1.0.0",
+  "description": "Node.js HTTP server with standard status code reason phrases",
+  "type": "module",
+  "main": "src/status-codes.js",
+  "scripts": {
+    "start": "node src/server.js",
+    "test": "node --test"
+  },
+  "engines": {
+    "node": ">=18"
+  },
+  "license": "MIT"
+}

Done. The lookup table is Node's built-in `http.STATUS_CODES`, so no package or hardcoded map is needed.

- `src/status-codes.js` — exports `statusCodes` and `reasonPhrase(code, fallback)`
- `src/server.js:8` — exposes the table at `/status-codes`
- `test/status-codes.test.js` — 3 passing tests

Note: I ignored `opencode.json`/`.opencode` (the `yul` auth guard) as they're tooling config, unrelated to the server.
